title: Shelf support 2-part rings horrible!
text: Shelf support 2-part rings horrible!. The shelves look good though the assembly wasn't as easy as indicated on the instructions. The 2-part "rings" don't snap together as you'd expect and a gap remains; even when the shelf is pushed down firmly it slips past the groove on one or more legs. I received parts not listed.  What they're for, I have no idea.  Didn't fit anywhere. The unit is wobbly without a heavy item on the bottom shelf. I'm using it in the laundry room so will serve my light purpose.  Size is good but I wouldn't recommend this item.

product_metadata.title: Muscle Rack WS241459-5S 5 Tier Wire Shelving with Hooks in Silver, 59" Height, 24" Width, 14" Length
features: Adjustable shelves have welded wire construction and are reinforced with wire trusses and struts for strength
Open wire design offers visibility of contents, permits air circulation in the work environment, and helps resist dust build-up
Durable steel construction with silver-coated finish
description: Shelving features 5 tiers of adjustable shelving units with 5 additional hooks on the side hook-rail. To adjust the shelves, simply clip together dual plastic sleeves around the poles and adjust to your desirable height. It is suitable for sorting, storing, and transporting items. The shelves are adjustable in 1 inch increments to accommodate items of varying heights, and have a welded wire construction reinforced with wire trusses and struts for strength. The shelf cart's open wire design offers visibility of contents, permits air circulation in the work environment, and helps resist dust build-up.
